card.name: The word has before been reported
card.fires_on: The auxiliary verb "has" right after a medical condition used as the subject, here "oligohydramnios has" before "been reported". It predicts a perfect-tense verb such as "been".

modes.label: has after a condition name
modes.description: The word "has" follows a condition noun and leads into "been infrequently reported".
modes.example: although oligohydramnios<< has>> been infrequently reported as soon as

card.writes: It promotes has and have forms, which suggests it pushes the model toward perfect-tense auxiliaries.
card.plain: It fires on the word "has" in a phrase like "this condition has been reported".
